objective: Candidate sifts ceramic media from steel washers; PR 2051 spins washed lettuce dry in a covered hand-crank salad spinner.
physical_skill: Both require stabilizing a container during dynamic loose-content motion. PR 2051 tests sustained crank rotation while keeping a lid and base stable; the candidate tests lifting, tilting or agitating a free screen so one solid class passes and another remains.
success_condition: PR 2051 scores time above a basket-speed threshold and requires final crank release, with lid, tilt, and displacement failures. The candidate scores actual separation outcome, washer retention, reseating, gripper clearance, and a 3-second dwell.
reason: PR 2051 tests rotary actuation and dewatering performance, not aperture-based separation of two solid populations.
